SELECT hire_date AS "hireDate", resign_date AS "resignDate" FROM gw_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.*, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm, u.email FROM gw_payroll p JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.pay_month = #{payMonth}

SELECT p.*, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm, u.email FROM gw_payroll p JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status_cd IN ('CONFIRMED','PAID') ORDER BY p.pay_month DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_payroll (user_id, pay_month, contract_id, work_days, absent_days, ot_min, night_min, holiday_min, taxable_pay, non_taxable_pay, gross_pay, deduction_total, net_pay, status_cd, paid_dt, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{payMonth}, #{contractId}, COALESCE(#{workDays}, 0), COALESCE(#{absentDays}, 0), COALESCE(#{otMin}, 0), COALESCE(#{nightMin}, 0), COALESCE(#{holidayMin}, 0), COALESCE(#{taxablePay}, 0), COALESCE(#{nonTaxablePay}, 0), COALESCE(#{grossPay}, 0), COALESCE(#{deductionTotal}, 0), COALESCE(#{netPay}, 0), COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'DRAFT'), #{paidDt}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_payroll SET contract_id = #{contractId}, work_days = COALESCE(#{workDays}, 0), absent_days = COALESCE(#{absentDays}, 0), ot_min = COALESCE(#{otMin}, 0), night_min = COALESCE(#{nightMin}, 0), holiday_min = COALESCE(#{holidayMin}, 0), taxable_pay = COALESCE(#{taxablePay}, 0), non_taxable_pay = COALESCE(#{nonTaxablePay}, 0), gross_pay = COALESCE(#{grossPay}, 0), deduction_total = COALESCE(#{deductionTotal}, 0), net_pay = COALESCE(#{netPay}, 0), status_cd = #{statusCd}, paid_dt = #{paidDt}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE pay_id = #{payId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_payroll_item (pay_id, kind_cd, code_val, item_nm, amount, taxable_yn, auto_yn, sort_no, memo) VALUES (#{payId}, #{kindCd}, #{codeVal}, #{itemNm}, #{amount}, COALESCE(#{taxableYn}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{autoYn}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{sortNo}, 0), #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_payroll_item WHERE pay_id = #{payId} ORDER BY kind_cd, sort_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_payroll_employer_cost (pay_id, insurance_cd, amount) VALUES (#{payId}, #{insuranceCd}, COALESCE(#{amount}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_payroll_employer_cost WHERE pay_id = #{payId} ORDER BY insurance_cd
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_payroll SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, paid_dt = #{paidDt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE pay_id = #{payId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ot_min), 0) AS ot_min, COALESCE(SUM(night_min), 0) AS night_min, COALESCE(SUM(holiday_min), 0) AS holiday_min, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd NOT IN ('HOLIDAY','ABSENT','LEAVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS work_days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS absent_days FROM gw_attendance WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND work_dt BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT d.dept_nm AS dept_nm, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(p.gross_pay), 0) AS gross_total, COALESCE(SUM(p.deduction_total), 0) AS deduction_total, COALESCE(SUM(p.net_pay), 0) AS net_total FROM gw_payroll p JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE p.pay_month = #{payMonth} GROUP BY d.dept_nm ORDER BY net_total DESC
